home.desc: Upload skins and capes, plug into the Yggdrasil API, and clients load them automatically. Premium players keep their real identity.
home.f1body: Plug into the Yggdrasil API, configure authlib-injector once, and clients load the skins and capes you upload.
home.f2body: Bind a Microsoft account. Premium players keep their real UUID, with skins falling back to Mojang.
home.f3body: Publish skins to the public library, like and comment, and share them with players on the same server.
